questions_and_answers.question_text: इस समय भारत के लोग क्या कर रहे होंगे ?

answers.answer_text: What might people in India be doing at this time?

questions_and_answers.question_text: क्या आपके परिवार के लोग इस समय सो रहे होंगे ?

answers.answer_text: Are your family members probably sleeping at this time?

questions_and_answers.question_text: आपके मित्र अब यहाँ पहुंचते होंगे ।

answers.answer_text: Your friends will probably be arriving here now.

questions_and_answers.question_text: शायद आज वे कहीं आराम करते होंगे ।

answers.answer_text: Perhaps today they will be resting somewhere.

questions_and_answers.question_text: आपके दोस्त ने अपना काम खत्म कर लिया होगा ।

answers.answer_text: Your friend must have finished his work.

questions_and_answers.question_text: उन्होंने मेरा पत्र लिख दिया होगा ।

answers.answer_text: They must have written my letter.
